definition: The United Kingdom's national geological survey and a component body of the Natural Environment Research Council; the Licensor of Information made available under the BGS Open, Non-Commercial Use and Viewer licences.
The UK's main agency for funding and managing research, training and knowledge exchange in the environmental sciences; a council of UK Research and Innovation.
The UK's national funding agency for research and innovation, and the body in which copyright in BGS materials vests.
